app.name: MUDHOTECH HR RECRUITING SYSTEM
app.tagline: Fair, explainable recruitment — people stay in control.

home.title: Find your next role
home.subtitle: Search vacancies from verified Zimbabwean employers. Every application is reviewed by people — AI only helps them find the evidence.
home.employersCta: Hiring? Post vacancies and screen fairly

areas.comingSoon: This area is being built. Check back soon.

states.errorBody: We couldn't load this. Please try again.
states.forbiddenTitle: You don't have access to this
states.notFoundBody: The page you're looking for doesn't exist or has moved.
states.serverErrorTitle: Something went wrong on our side
states.serverErrorBody: Please try again. If the problem continues, contact support and quote the reference below.

validation.mustAcceptTerms: You need to accept the terms to continue.
validation.invalidCode: Enter the code from your authenticator app or a recovery code.
validation.invalidUrl: Enter a full web address starting with http:// or https://.
validation.invalidCountry: Use the 2-letter country code, e.g. ZW.
validation.outOfRange: This value is outside the allowed range.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Welcome back. Sign in to continue.
login.genericError: We couldn't sign you in with those details. Check them and try again.
login.mfaBody: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login.mfaCodeHelp: Lost your device? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
login.invalidCode: That code didn't work. Try again.
login.verifyBody: We sent a confirmation link to your email address.
login.verifyHint: Open the link in that email to activate your account, then sign in. Check your spam folder if you can't find it.

register.title: Create your account
register.subtitle: Apply for jobs and track your applications in one place.
register.passwordHelp: At least {min} characters. A short phrase you can remember works well.
register.termsLabel: I agree to the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and have read the <privacy>Privacy notice</privacy>.
register.checkInboxBody: If {email} can be used, we've sent a link to confirm it.
register.checkInboxHint: Open the link in the email to finish creating your account. It can take a few minutes to arrive.

verify.title: Confirm your email address
verify.body: Select the button below to confirm this email address belongs to you.
verify.doneBody: Thanks - your email address is confirmed.
verify.invalidTitle: This link has expired or was already used
verify.invalidBody: Sign in and we'll send you a fresh confirmation link.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to reset it.
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for that address, we've sent a link to reset the password. The link works once and expires in 1 hour.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.doneBody: Your password has been changed. You can now sign in.
reset.expiredTitle: This reset link is no longer valid
reset.expiredBody: Reset links work once and expire after 1 hour. Request a new one.

gate.forbiddenBody: Your account doesn't have access to this area.
gate.mfaBanner: Your role requires two-factor authentication. Please <link>set it up</link> before {date}.

account.title: Account security
account.subtitle: Manage your password, email, two-factor authentication and signed-in devices.

reauth.title: Confirm it's you
reauth.body: For your security, enter your password to continue.

email.title: Email address
email.help: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. Your current address stays active until you confirm.
email.sent: We sent a confirmation link to {email}.

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.description: Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, Authy…).
mfa.graceBody: Set up two-factor authentication before {date} to keep access to HR features.
mfa.enforcedBody: Access to HR features is paused until you set up two-factor authentication.
mfa.step1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (or enter the key manually).
mfa.step2: Enter the 6-digit code the app shows.
mfa.qrAlt: QR code to add this account to an authenticator app
mfa.codesBody: Store these somewhere safe. Each code works once if you lose your device.

sessions.title: Signed-in devices
sessions.description: Sign out of devices you don't recognise.
sessions.revokeOthers: Sign out of all other devices
sessions.revokedCount: Signed out of {count, plural, one {# device} other {# devices}}.

fields.name: Organisation name
fields.countryHelp: Two letters, e.g. ZW for Zimbabwe.
fields.descriptionHelp: Shown on your public careers page. Basic formatting only.

employers.title: Hire fairly and faster
employers.subtitle: Advertise vacancies, receive applications and get evidence-based shortlist suggestions - your HR team stays in control of every decision.
employers.point1: Approved, versioned criteria for every vacancy
employers.point2: AI-assisted screening that shows its evidence - never automatic rejections
employers.point3: Shortlists approved by people, with a complete audit trail
employers.point4: Built for Zimbabwe's data protection law (CDPA)

create.signInFirst: Create a free account (or sign in) first, then set up your organisation.
create.verificationNotice: New organisations are reviewed by MudhoTech before vacancies can be published. You can prepare drafts straight away.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Organisation profile, structure, team and policies.
settings.pendingVerification: Your organisation is awaiting verification. You can prepare vacancies, but publishing is enabled after verification.
settings.suspended: This organisation is suspended. Recruitment data is read-only.
settings.logoHelp: PNG, JPEG or WebP up to 2 MB. Shown on your careers page.
settings.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

team.name: Name
team.deactivateBody: They will be signed out everywhere and lose access to this organisation. Their past actions stay in the audit log.
team.deactivated: Member deactivated. {count, plural, =0 {No work needs reassigning.} one {# item needs a new owner.} other {# items need a new owner.}}
team.invitationsHelp: Invitations expire after 7 days and can be used once.
team.forbidden: Only company admins and HR managers can view the team.

policies.aiHelp: AI only ever suggests. People approve every shortlist and decision.
policies.ai_enabled_help: Extract evidence from CVs and suggest how well applications match your approved criteria.
policies.llm_enabled_help: Off by default. When on, only redacted text is sent to the configured provider.
policies.blind_review_default_help: Hide candidate names during the first review to reduce bias.
policies.hide_ai_from_panelists: Hide AI scores from interview panels
policies.hide_ai_from_panelists_help: Prevents anchoring on AI suggestions during interviews.
policies.shortlist_dual_control_help: The person who proposes a shortlist cannot approve it.
policies.rubric_dual_control_help: The person who writes a rubric cannot approve it.
policies.duplicate_policy: Repeat applications to the same vacancy
policies.duplicate_allow_resubmit_replace: A new application replaces the previous one
policies.stale: Someone else changed these policies. We've loaded the latest values - review and save again.
policies.readOnly: Only company admins can change policies.
policies.forbidden: Only company admins and HR managers can view policies.

invitation.title: Join {org}
invitation.body: You've been invited as {role}. The invitation was sent to {email}.
invitation.signedInAs: Signed in as {email}. You must use the invited email address.
invitation.invalidBody: This invitation link isn't valid. Ask your admin to send a new one.
invitation.status_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your admin to resend it.
invitation.status_accepted: This invitation has already been used.
invitation.genericError: We couldn't accept the invitation. Please try again.

organisations.title: Organisations
organisations.subtitle: Verify new employers and manage tenant status. Every action is audited.
organisations.search: Search by name or registration number
organisations.name: Organisation
organisations.verifyBody: Verified organisations can publish vacancies. Confirm you have checked their registration details.
organisations.suspendBody: Their public vacancies will be hidden, staff become read-only and processing pauses. Candidates see that recruitment is paused.
organisations.reactivateBody: Staff regain normal access. If the organisation was never verified it returns to pending verification.
organisations.error: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
